playbook.title: Contra (T+2)
playbook.desc: Ride a 1-3 day momentum burst and sell before payment is due. Highest risk, smallest size.
rules: Signal: close above the 20-day high, volume 2x+, close in the top 25% of the day's range, up 2%+
Average daily value at least 2x the normal liquidity filter
Buy at the next open only if the gap is 2% or less
Stop: below the signal day's low (max 4%). Target: 1.5x the risk
Sell by the close of T+2 no matter what. Risk 0.5% of capital
Effective gearing 4-8x, delta 0.5 or higher (at or in the money)
Tight bid-ask spread (1 tick) and a market maker quoting size
Any expiry over 2 months is fine for a 2-day hold

playbook.title: Short term (up to 1 month)
playbook.desc: Swing, breakout, volume and candlestick setups from the main scanner, ranked with theme strength.
rules: Entry: buy-stop above the setup high, valid 2 days
Stop: below the setup low; target 2.0R; time exit after 15 days
Risk 1% of capital (half in weak markets)
